apps.name: Paruto Kids World
apps.tagline: An explorable 3D village where little ones learn and play.
apps.description: A browser-based 3D village for children aged 2–5. Kids walk around with Jas, Jay and baby Joe, step into buildings like the market, farm and story house, and play gentle learning games for letters and counting. A grown-up gate keeps the parent area separate, with safeguarding built in from day one.
highlights: Walkable 3D world with six zones
Three complete learning games
Parent area behind a grown-up gate

apps.name: Naija Hustle
apps.tagline: A multiplayer life simulation set in the streets of Lagos.
apps.description: A persistent, mobile-first browser life sim set in Nigerian cities. Start in Lagos, earn, trade and build a life alongside other players in a living, server-driven economy.
highlights: Multiplayer, persistent world
Mobile-first
Starting with Lagos — Block One

media.caption: Claim your username and start with ₦10m

apps.name: Casefile Africa
apps.tagline: A 3D detective game: solve crimes and build cases that hold up in court.
apps.description: A premium, browser-based 3D investigation game. You play an investigator with a fictional federal agency: examine crime scenes, interview witnesses, send evidence to the lab and build a case that stands up in court. Case 001, The Maitama Ledger, opens at a rain-soaked murder scene in an upscale Abuja estate.
highlights: Explore 3D crime scenes in first person
Interview witnesses who remember, trust and lie
Fair-play cases: every answer can be deduced from the evidence

media.caption: The investigator device and case file

apps.name: My Mama
apps.tagline: A private women's-health companion, experienced as a warm 3D village.
apps.description: My Mama is a women's-health companion you explore as a calm 3D village. Walk the village, keep a private journal, track your cycle and prepare for care, at your own pace and through every stage of life. It offers information and a place to record your health; it does not diagnose.
highlights: A calm 3D village to explore
Private by default: your journal and records stay yours
Support through every stage of life

media.caption: A warm place to look after yourself

apps.name: Paruto Galleries
apps.tagline: Private photo and film delivery for Paruto Media clients.
apps.description: Paruto Media's client-gallery service. Clients open a private link, optionally password-protected, to view their photos and films, favourite and send selections, and download them, without ever creating an account.
highlights: Private gallery links, with optional passwords
Favourite, select and download in one place
No client accounts needed

apps.name: Paruto Finance
apps.tagline: Mobile-first accounting for invoices, payments, expenses and project profitability.
apps.description: A mobile-first accounting platform for managing invoices, receipts, payments, expenses and project profitability. Built for Paruto and designed to scale to other organisations, it brings multi-currency finances, approvals and financial reporting into one simple workspace.
highlights: Invoices, receipts, payments and expenses in one workspace
Multi-currency, with approvals built in
Project profitability and financial reporting

apps.name: ChurchSense
apps.tagline: Turn attendance, giving, follow-up and ministry data into clear insights and action.
apps.description: A church operations and ministry intelligence platform. ChurchSense helps churches capture attendance, track giving and follow-up, manage users and locations, generate reports and monitor ministry health. Built for pastors, administrators, service leaders and ministry teams, with role-based access, location-level reporting, dashboards, notifications, AI-powered insights and mobile-friendly workflows.
highlights: Attendance, giving and follow-up in one place
Role-based access and location-level reporting
AI-powered insights for church leaders

apps.name: Paruto Bid
apps.tagline: AI-powered bid management, from tender discovery to submission-ready proposals.
apps.description: An AI-powered procurement and bid management platform. Paruto Bid analyses RFPs, tracks compliance requirements, organises evidence and past performance, and supports technical and financial proposal development, helping teams manage bids with greater accuracy, speed and control.
highlights: Analyse RFPs and track compliance requirements
Organise evidence and past performance
Develop technical and financial proposals together
